name: browser-modes
description: A Claude Code skill: pick the right browser-automation mode before any Playwright/web task — headless (default, invisible to the user), a visible window when login/auth is needed (opened up front, not after faceplanting into a login wall), or handover that attaches to the user's real, already-open Chrome only when they explicitly ask. Stops agents from narrating a headless browser as if the user can see it.
